svg.title: Designators that read from two edges of the board, not four
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Two copies of the same small area of a board with eight 0603 resistors and capacitors, some placed horizontally and some vertically, with designators 1 mm tall. Left, recommended: every horizontal designator reads left to right from the bottom edge, and every vertical designator reads bottom to top, from the right edge, so a person only ever holds the board one of two ways. Right, avoid: the designators are turned every way, some upside down and some reading top to bottom, so the board has to be turned to all four sides to read them.

g.text: Horizontal designators read left to right
Vertical designators all read bottom to top
From the right edge, a quarter turn
Drawn to scale. 0603 parts, designators 1 mm tall.
The blue arrows show the edges a person reads from.
